ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_FINANCIALPRODUCT_TRU
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT
    BTT.PRODUCT_CODE,
    BTT.PRODUCT_NAME,
    BTT.PRODUCT_DESC,
    BTT.MIN_AMT,
    BTT.MAX_AMT,
    BTT.MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
    BTT.INV_TYPE,
    BTT.MIN_CURRENCY,
    BTT.MAX_CURRENCY,
    BTT.PROD_CLASS,
    BTT.AUM_NOM,
    BTT.REJECT_REASON,
    BTT.BR_CD,
    BTT.RESERVE_PER,
    BTTD.RECORD_STATUS,
    BTT.INSERT_DTTM,
    BTT.BNK_CODE
    FROM BUSC.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_DELTA BTTD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS BTT ON BTT.PRODUCT_CODE = BTTD.PRODUCT_CODE AND BTT.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
PRODUCT_CODE,
PRODUCT_NAME,
PRODUCT_DESC,
MIN_AMT,
MAX_AMT,
MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
INV_TYPE, 
MIN_CURRENCY,
MAX_CURRENCY,
PROD_CLASS,
AUM_NOM,
REJECT_REASON,
BR_CD,
RESERVE_PER
)) HASHROW, PRODUCT_CODE, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
FinancialProductId,
FinancialProductName,
FinancialProductDescription,
ProductMinimumAmount,
ProductMaximumAmount,
ProductMinimumTerm,
InvestmentTypeId,
MinCurrencyCode,
MaxCurrencyCode,
ProductClass,
AumNom,
RejectReason,
BranchId,
ReservePercentage
)) HASHROW, FinancialProductId
FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR,
TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR,
ISNULL(SRC.PRODUCT_CODE, TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId,
CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT TGT ON SRC.PRODUCT_CODE = TGT.FinancialProductId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[FinancialProductId] = SRC.PRODUCT_CODE,
[FinancialProductName] = SRC.PRODUCT_NAME,
FinancialProductDescription = SRC.PRODUCT_DESC,
ProductShortDescription = NULL,
ProductInternalName = NULL,
ProductIntendedUse = NULL,
ProductIntroductionDate = NULL,
ProductFirstSaleDate = NULL,
PlannedAbandonmentDate = NULL,
ActualAbandonmentDate = NULL,
ProductMinimumAmount = SRC.MIN_AMT,
ProductMaximumAmount = SRC.MAX_AMT,
ProductMinimumTerm = SRC.MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
ProductMaximumTerm = NULL,
UnitOfMeasureId = NULL,
NetContentUomId = NULL,
ProductNote = NULL,
PerAccountInsuranceLimitAmount = NULL,
InsuranceTypeId = NULL,
GoverningLawState = NULL,
CusipNumber = NULL,
GlobalTradeItemNumber = NULL,
GtinName = NULL,
EuropeanArticleNumber = NULL,
UniversalProductCode = NULL,
ItemElectronicProductCode = NULL,
ComponentPartIdentifier = NULL,
ProductInformationContactTelephoneNumber = NULL,
ProductInformationWwwUrl = NULL,
CustomerServiceTelephoneNumber = NULL,
PatentNumber = NULL,
PatentDate = NULL,
PatentExpirationDate = NULL,
Trademark = NULL,
ProductLogo = NULL,
CopyrightNumber = NULL,
CopyrightDate = NULL,
ProductLicenserName = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionIndicator = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionStartDate = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionEndDate = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionDescription = NULL,
ApprovalProcessStatement = NULL,
LegalDisclosureStatement = NULL,
PrivacyStatement = NULL,
InformationSharingStatement = NULL,
ProductAgreementCoverageStatement = NULL,
AcceptanceOfAgreementStatement = NULL,
RelationshipToOtherAgreementsStatement = NULL,
ProductUsageStatement = NULL,
ProductTermsAndConditionsStatement = NULL,
ProductChargesStatement = NULL,
PaymentCalculationStatement = NULL,
ProductServiceHoursStatement = NULL,
ChangesToAgreementStatement = NULL,
ServiceCancellationStatement = NULL,
DisclosureOfInformationStatement = NULL,
LimitationOfLiabilityStatement = NULL,
BankLiabilityStatement = NULL,
ServiceLimitationsStatement = NULL,
ChangesOrCancellationStatement = NULL,
MinimumAgeToOpenAccount = NULL,
MarketingMessageDescription = NULL,
[24HourInformationLineIndicator] = NULL,
OnLineBankingAvailableIndicator = NULL,
MonthlyStatementsIndicator = NULL,
AtmAccessIndicator = NULL,
PhoneBankingIndicator = NULL,
PrepaymentPenaltyIndicator = NULL,
AccelerationClauseIndicator = NULL,
ProductHasTrackingStatusAvailableIndicator = NULL,
AccountToAccountTransfersIndicator = NULL,
CoBrandedProductIndicator = NULL,
ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL,
CoBrandingOrganizationName = NULL,
ProductTypeId = NULL,
IsoCurrencyCode = NULL,
ProductInsuranceTypeId = NULL,
PrimaryBrandId = NULL,
WarrantyId = NULL,
PrimaryCountryOfOriginCountryId = NULL,
InvestmentTypeId = SRC.INV_TYPE,
MinCurrencyCode = SRC.MIN_CURRENCY,
MaxCurrencyCode = SRC.MAX_CURRENCY,
ProductClass = SRC.PROD_CLASS,
AumNom = SRC.AUM_NOM,
RejectReason = SRC.REJECT_REASON,
BranchId = SRC.BR_CD,
ReservePercentage = SRC.RESERVE_PER,
[SourceSystemCode] = 'TRU',
[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BNK_CODE,
[WorkFlowId] = 0,
[TaskRunId] = 0,
[InsertDttm] = GETDATE()

FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.PRODUCT_CODE = TGT.FinancialProductId;

SELECT
PRODUCT_CODE as FinancialProductId,
PRODUCT_NAME as FinancialProductName,
PRODUCT_DESC as FinancialProductDescription,
NULL AS ProductShortDescription,

NULL AS ProductIntendedUse,

NULL AS ProductFirstSaleDate,

MAX_AMT AS ProductMaximumAmount,
MIN_HOLD_PERIOD AS ProductMinimumTerm,
NULL AS ProductMaximumTerm,
NULL AS UnitOfMeasureId,
NULL AS NetContentUomId,
NULL AS ProductNote,
NULL AS PerAccountInsuranceLimitAmount,
NULL AS InsuranceTypeId,
NULL AS GoverningLawState,
NULL AS CusipNumber,
NULL AS GlobalTradeItemNumber,
NULL AS GtinName,
NULL AS EuropeanArticleNumber,
NULL AS UniversalProductCode,

NULL AS ComponentPartIdentifier,
NULL AS ProductInformationContactTelephoneNumber,
NULL AS ProductInformationWwwUrl,

NULL AS CoBrandedProductIndicator,

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
